description: This file defines a Java class `MediaContentJob` that extends `JobService`. It provides functionality for scheduling, checking, and canceling a job that monitors changes to media content URIs using Android's JobScheduler API. The class includes methods to handle job start and stop events, schedule the job, check if it's scheduled, and cancel it. It also implements logic to respond to content changes and display Toast notifications.

classes.name: MediaContentJob
classes.description: A JobService subclass that monitors media content changes using Android's JobScheduler API. It allows scheduling, canceling, and responding to content change events, providing user feedback via Toast notifications and logs.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules a job to monitor content URI changes using JobScheduler.

methods.name: isScheduled
methods.description: Checks if the media content job is currently scheduled.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels the media content monitoring job.

methods.name: onStartJob
methods.description: Handles the event when the job starts; shows a Toast with changed content authorities and URIs, and sets up a delayed task for further processing.

methods.name: onStopJob
methods.description: Handles the event when the job is stopped; cancels any pending tasks.
